inputs.text: A polished professional ORIGINAL top-down adventure game character asset sheet: precisely 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated full-body characters, one centered character per equal square cell with generous blank margin. Same camera for all, three-quarter overhead, feet toward bottom, cozy hand-painted pixel-art, chunky readable silhouettes, warm amber upper-left light, teal shadows, apricot and cream details. Read left-to-right top-to-bottom: Row1 elderly female seed keeper in moss coat with round seed bag; gentle tall botanist wearing a glass visor and leaf cloak; female sea cartographer with navy coat and brass compass; female copper mechanic with orange overalls and goggles. Row2 female pilot in cream flight jacket and short blue scarf; young mail carrier with red satchel; small elderly seated traveler carrying a kettle; dark teal mischievous shadow creature with two cyan eyes and little claw feet. Row3 massive but kind moss-covered stone forest guardian with a glowing cyan heart; elegant emerald crystal stag; huge turquoise turtle with a tiny ceramic lighthouse on shell; round ornate copper clockwork automaton with cream dial chest. Row4 large folded-wing silver tin bird with blue feather edges; mysterious dark root creature with small golden inner glow; cheerful flower seller with basket; small floating teal shadow wisp. Entire background pure flat saturated MAGENTA #ff00ff, no magenta inside subjects. No ground, no scenery, no text, no cell border, no grid lines, no watermark. Exactly one character per cell, separated, consistent style, no copyrighted characters.
